tour.welcomeBody: This short tour walks you through everything you need to run your hotel — from check-in to daily closing. You can replay it anytime from the help button in the header.
tour.sidebarBody: Everything is organised by workflow: Overview, Front Desk, Property, Money and Operations. Items you see depend on your role — front-desk staff and housekeeping see only what they need.
tour.statusCardsBody: A real-time snapshot of your property: total rooms, occupied, available, reserved, cleaning and maintenance. These update automatically as bookings, check-ins and housekeeping move rooms through their lifecycle.
tour.inhouseBody: Guests currently staying with you, their rooms, expected check-out and payment status — so the front desk always knows who is in the building and who has dues.
tour.quickActionsBody: One-click shortcuts to the most frequent front-desk jobs: start a check-in, process a check-out, review room status or open billing history.
tour.checkinBody: The full arrival workflow: find the booking, verify the guest with ID photos, add co-guests, capture emergency contact and vehicle details, pick chargeable services, and confirm — the room turns Occupied automatically.
tour.roomsBody: Manage room types, rooms and their live states. Rooms follow a strict lifecycle — Available → Reserved → Occupied → Cleaning → Available — so double booking is impossible.
tour.paymentsBody: Collect Cash or UPI payments, add folio charges, and see the append-only guest ledger with a running balance. Refunds and corrections never overwrite history.
tour.expensesBody: Record expenses with categories and vendors. Each expense flows Draft → Submitted → Approved → Paid, and recurring templates create drafts automatically.
tour.reportsBody: Occupancy, revenue, payment methods, GST breakdowns per booking and expense summaries — with date filters and CSV export.
tour.bellBody: Alerts about your hotel show up here — renewals, approvals and operational events.
tour.localeBody: Switch the entire interface between English and Hindi at any time.
tour.planBody: View plans, check your expiry date and request a renewal here. If your plan ever expires, transactions pause until it is renewed.
tour.doneBody: That's the essentials. Explore each section from the sidebar — and if you ever need this tour again, click the help icon in the header.
